name: Limit
summary:
This game is about defeating monsters with your dash ability. Every time you hit a monster you can attack again without needing to land on the ground. When you reach a certain number of combo attacks, will make you go into Limit mode, which makes you dash much further and quicker. The goal of the game is to beat the boss of the game as many times as possible, but every time you defeat him, the harder the dungeon will become.

This was a game created in 7 days for the Blackthornprog Game Jam.
Theme: Less Is More
The less you touch the ground the more damage you deal.
